title: Espresso Gelato Cookie Affogato
hookLine: Hot double espresso poured directly over frozen fior di latte gelato & a crisp cookie rim.

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {gelato_af} and {esp_af} and keep toppings like {biscoff_af} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Pour Hot Espresso Over Frozen Scoops
steps.instructionTemplate: Place {gelato_af} into chilled glasses, scatter {biscoff_af}, and pour steaming {esp_af} straight over top to create instant caramelized espresso foam.
steps.creatorSecret: Freeze your serving glasses 15 mins ahead so the gelato forms a delicious iced espresso shell.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {biscoff_af} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Espresso Gelato Cookie Affogato flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 2 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 3 mins.
